cover_letter:
Dear Puratos Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Product Communication Manager Sourdough position at Puratos. Your mission to bring sourdough expertise to life through clear storytelling and high-quality content aligns perfectly with my experience in digital marketing, content creation and web management.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I have honed my ability to translate complex information into compelling, audience-focused stories. I build and optimize websites for both traditional and AI-powered search, write SEO content that ranks, and use AI tools to automate repetitive tasks. For example, at Knowledge Experts, I supported the team in building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for major clients like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, which required structuring content logically for internal audiences. I also manage CMS content for client websites, ensuring consistency across pages, blog posts and media.

My technical background allows me to collaborate effectively with developers and designers, and my experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console helps me monitor and improve communication impact. I am fluent in English and comfortable using digital communication tools, and I enjoy working across teams to ensure content is relevant and aligned.

While I may not have direct experience in the bakery sector, I have a strong affinity for food and a proven ability to quickly grasp new domains. I am eager to apply my skills to the Sourdough Institute and contribute to Puratos's growth.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can help strengthen the Sourdough Institute's narrative and create memorable customer experiences.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok
